answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through a scarce-slot auction mechanism. Each new identity must secure a unique registration slot, with costs increasing by 20 tokens for every additional participant. This structure means that established users can join freely, while newcomers face escalating fees that could reach over 500 tokens for just a few fake accounts. As dawn breaks on this innovative system, an attacker could find themselves struggling to climb a knoll, weighed down by the heavy fable of expenses they must bear to create even a small cluster of illegitimate identities.
